cohort: The study included 4,452 women aged 15-49 in the Philippines who had given birth within the previous three years.
finding: Socioeconomic disparities are strongly associated with Cesarean section delivery in the Philippines, with wealthier mothers being significantly more likely to have a CS.
mod_finding: Socioeconomic disparities are strongly associated with Cesarean section delivery in the Philippines, with wealthier mothers being significantly more likely to have a CS.
cross-section timing: Data from the 2022 Philippines National Demographic and Health Survey (NDHS), covering births within the three years prior to the survey.
